description: Opens the human's own bank accounts (vIBANs in GBP, EUR and USD) that fund their agent payments. Moves no money. Two ways: called WITHOUT identity fields (preferred, private) it returns a one-time link, valid 10 minutes, where the human enters their own details — nothing passes through this chat; called WITH all identity fields (first and last name, date of birth, phone, home address) it opens the accounts at once. Pass identity only when the human has typed it here and agreed to share it. ArisPay forwards identity to its bank partner and stores none of it. Idempotent: already-open accounts are returned as they are. Select this when balance says there is no bank account yet; use balance afterwards for the account details.

countryCode.description: Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 (GBR, IRL, FRA, DEU, USA, ...).

email.description: Defaults to the ArisPay account's email.

phoneNumber.description: Mobile number in E.164 form, e.g. +447700900123.

name: open_bank_account
